title: hieracium caucasiense subsp. acutangulum
intro: Hieracium caucasiense subsp. acutangulum, commonly known as Caucasian hawkweed, is a plant species within the dandelion family (Asteraceae) that is native to the mountainous regions of the Caucasus. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include treating fever, inflammation, and digestive issues due to its ability to stimulate digestion and relieve pain. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium caucasiense subsp. acutangulum include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, making it useful for treating respiratory issues and relieving symptoms of colds and flu. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
